name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme Tranche-I under National Programme on High Efficiency Solar PV Modules
benefit:
> **Incentive Benefit:**

1. Production Linked Incentive (PLI) to eligible manufacturers.
1. Financial outlay: ₹4,500 crore.
1. PLI available for 5 years from commissioning or scheduled commissioning date, whichever is earlier.
1. PLI calculation formula:
1. PLI (₹) = Sales Volume (Wp) × Base PLI Rate (₹/Wp) × Tapering Factor × Local Value Addition.

> **Additional Benefit Conditions:**

1. PLI am
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a manufacturer proposing minimum integration across solar cells and modules. 1. The applicant should undertake to set up a manufacturing plant of minimum 1,000 MW capacity. 1. The applicant should meet minimum module performance parameters: 1. Minimum module efficiency of 19.50% with temperature coefficient better than -0.30% per degree Celsius; or 1. Minimum module efficiency of 20% with temperature coefficient equal to or better than -0.40% per degree Celsius. 1. The applicant may be a single company or Joint Venture/Consortium, subject to scheme conditions. 1. The applicant may be a Greenfield project. Brownfield projects may participate subject to prescribed eligibility criteria.
